registration.name: code-implementation
registration.description: Implements a single ticket's acceptance criteria against the coding charter. Dispatched by the execute-work skill with the ticket's layered body, any RFC/TDD context, and — on a retry — the verifier's itemized failures. Writes and edits code and tests; it never commits, branches, or opens PRs (the orchestrating skill owns git). Use when a ticket needs to be built.

registration.name: code-implementation-escalated
registration.description: Implements the final attempt for a ticket after two recorded verifier rejections. Shares the code-implementation instructions, acceptance criteria and structured report; use only on attempt three of execute-work.

registration.name: code-verifier
registration.description: Verifies acceptance criteria and accepted review fixes, or triages review findings before remediation. Dispatched by the execute-work skill after code-implementation runs. Read-only — it inspects code and runs tests but never edits anything. Use to independently confirm a ticket is actually done.

registration.name: qa-engineer
registration.description: Reproduces a bug or verifies a bug fix or a story in the running product, following the repo's QA instructions — usually driving the web client through playwright-cli and capturing screenshots and a one-take recording, otherwise the API, CLI, Salesforce org, or cloud account those instructions describe. Dispatched by reproduce-bug in reproduce mode; the qa-engineer-verify registration shares these instructions for verify-ticket in verify mode. Read-and-run only: it never writes to the tracker, git, or a PR, never fixes anything, and never prompts. Use when a ticket needs to be seen working, or failing, in a live environment.

registration.name: qa-engineer-verify
registration.description: Verifies a recorded bug fix or story contract in the running product in verify mode. Shares the qa-engineer capture protocol and structured report; use for verify-ticket rather than initial symptom investigation.

registration.name: research-agent
registration.description: Single-shot investigator that answers one focused research brief by reading code and/or searching the web, and returns a structured, mode-typed findings report. Dispatch one per question; parallel fan-out is the caller's job. Use for grounding decomposition/planning in real code, or for ad-hoc questions like "does library X support Y, and how do I do it with the Z SDK?".

registration.name: tech-writer
registration.description: Reviews, rewrites, or authors human-readable prose — RFCs, tickets, design docs, READMEs, PR descriptions, release notes — against the bundled prose charter, and strips machine-writing tells. Dispatched by the review-prose skill in feedback (findings only) or rewrite (proposes exact edits the skill applies) mode, and by execute-work in author mode to construct a PR body from change context. Read-only; it never writes files and never touches code. Use when a written artifact needs to read like a human wrote it.
